072/**
073 * Track some global state for a row set.
074 * Access to some of this state is delegate to other classes in this package.
075 */
076public class RowSetState {

079  private boolean preInsertOps;
080  //private NavigateState navigateState;
081  private final WeakReference<RowSet> rsRef;
082
083  private RowSetState(RowSet rs) {
084    rsRef = new WeakReference<>(rs);
085    debugRowSetListener = DebugRowSetListener.create(rs); // May be null.
086  }
087  // TODO: fix when case sensitivity handled in plugin.
088  // Ignore case for column names as key.
089  private final Map<String, Boolean> keys = new TreeMap<>(String.CASE_INSENSITIVE_ORDER);
090  /**
091   * Determine if the column in our rowset is a primary key.
092   * Throw an exception if problem is encountered.
093   *
094   * @param columnName Must be a column in associated RowSet.
095   * @return true if primary key else false
096   */
097  // TODO: isKey: base this on labelName, not columnName?
098  private boolean isKey(String columnName) {
099    if (columnName == null) // POSSIBLE?. IF POSSIBLE, WHY CAN'T IT BE A KEY?
100      throw new IllegalArgumentException("null column name");
101    RowSet rs = rsRef.get();
102    if (rs == null)
103      throw new IllegalStateException("must be a rowset");
104
105    Boolean rv = keys.get(columnName);
106    if (rv != null)
107      return rv;
108    // This method is frequently used, create a map entry for each column
109    // Saving each RowSets column minimizes metadata access.
110    // May want to cache more metadata info in the future.
111    try {
112      List<String> names = SsUtils.getPrimaryKeyInfoForTable(rs, columnName)
113                               .stream()
114                               .map((ki) -> ki.columnName())
115                               .toList();
116      ResultSetMetaData rsMetaData = rs.getMetaData();
117      for (int i = 1; i <= rsMetaData.getColumnCount(); i++) {
118        String name = rsMetaData.getColumnName(i);
119        keys.put(name, names.contains(name));
120      }
121
122    } catch (SQLException ex) {
123      // TODO: isKey: random SQLEX report. No exception?
124      throw new IllegalStateException(ex);
125    }
126    rv = keys.get(columnName);
127    if (rv == null)
128      throw new IllegalArgumentException(sf("Column not in RowSet: %s", columnName));
129    return rv;
130  }
131

150   * Is the current row of the RowSet dirty?
151   * @return is dirty
152   */

154    return getNavigateState() != null && getNavigateState().undoRow.isDirty();
155  }
156
157  NavigateState getNavigateState() {

159  }

163  @SuppressWarnings("unused")
164  private final RowSetListener debugRowSetListener; // Strong reference needed.
165  private static class DebugRowSetListener implements RowSetListener {
166    static RowSetListener create(RowSet rs) {
167      if (defLookup(DebugRowSetListenerFlag.class) == null)
168        return null;
169      DebugRowSetListener l = new DebugRowSetListener();
170      rs.addRowSetListener(WeakListeners.create(RowSetListener.class, l, rs));
171      return l;
172    }
173
174    @Override
175    @SuppressWarnings("UseOfSystemOutOrSystemErr")
176    public void rowSetChanged(RowSetEvent event) {
177      String s = sf("DEBUG: %s: %s", ROW_SET_CHANGED, objectID(event.getSource()));
178      System.err.println(s);
179    }
180
181    @Override
182    @SuppressWarnings("UseOfSystemOutOrSystemErr")
183    public void rowChanged(RowSetEvent event) {
184      String s = sf("DEBUG: %s: %s", ROW_CHANGED, objectID(event.getSource()));
185      System.err.println(s);
186    }
187
188    @Override
189    @SuppressWarnings("UseOfSystemOutOrSystemErr")
190    public void cursorMoved(RowSetEvent event) {
191      String s = sf("DEBUG: %s: %s", CURSOR_MOVED, objectID(event.getSource()));
192      System.err.println(s);
193    }
194  }

306   */

316   * @param rs check this rowset
317   * @return true if executing acceptingChanges
318   */
319  public static boolean isAcceptingCachedRowSetChanges(RowSet rs) {
320    return rs == null ? false : getRowSetState(rs).isAcceptingCachedRowSetChanges();
321  }

323  /**
324   * A {@linkplain CachedRowSet} requires an extra step to effect changes
325   * in its underlying data source;
326   * this method does {@link CachedRowSet#acceptChanges() } on the
327   * specified {@linkplain CachedRowSet}.
328   * Set the state for the CachedRowSet so that it's listeners can ignore
329   * the extra events while the changes are accepted.
330   * @param crs accept change on this.
331   * @throws SQLException
332   */
333  public static void acceptCachedRowSetChanges(CachedRowSet crs) throws SQLException {
334    try {
335      setAcceptingCachedRowSetChanges(crs, true);
336      crs.acceptChanges();
337    } finally {
338      setAcceptingCachedRowSetChanges(crs, false);
339    }
340  }
341
342  /**
343   * A {@linkplain CachedRowSet} requires an extra step to effect changes
344   * in its underlying data source;
345   * this method does {@link CachedRowSet#acceptChanges() } on the
346   * specified {@linkplain CachedRowSet}.
347   * Set the state for the CachedRowSet so that it's listeners can ignore
348   * the extra events while the changes are accepted.
349   * The runnable {@code runAfterChanges}, if not null, is executed after
350   * acceptChanges on the CachedRowSet is successful.
351   * @param crs accept change on this.
352   * @param runAfterCachedRowSetChanges execute if not null
353   * @throws SQLException
354   */
355  //
356  // TODO: Flag to always runAfterChanges - if not then skip if SQL error,
357  //         Maybe instead of runnable,
358  //         something that contains the flag,
359  //         something that can throw SQLException,
360  //         something that gets sqlEx,
361  //
362  @SuppressWarnings("unused")
363  private static void NOT_USED_acceptCachedRowSetChanges(CachedRowSet crs,
364                                                         Runnable runAfterCachedRowSetChanges)
365      throws SQLException {
366    SyncProviderException syncEx = null;
367    Exception afterEx = null;
368    try {
369      setAcceptingCachedRowSetChanges(crs, true);
370      crs.acceptChanges();
371      //if (runAfterChanges != null) {
372      //    runAfterChanges.run();      // assume if acceptChanges throws, don't need "code"
373      //}
374    } catch (SyncProviderException ex) {
375      syncEx = ex;
376    } finally {
377      if (runAfterCachedRowSetChanges != null) {
378        try {
379          runAfterCachedRowSetChanges.run();
380        } catch (Exception ex) {
381          afterEx = ex;
382        }
383      }
384      setAcceptingCachedRowSetChanges(crs, false);
385    }
386    if (syncEx != null) {
387      if (afterEx == null)
388        throw syncEx;
389      else
390        throw new NOT_USED_SqlSyncProviderException("Exception after Sync", syncEx, afterEx);
391    }
392
393    if (syncEx != null || afterEx != null)
394      throw new NOT_USED_SqlSyncProviderException("handling aceptChanges", syncEx, afterEx);
395  }
396
397  /**
398   *
399   * A wrapper exception for exceptions that occur while the SS library is
400   * accepting changes to a {@link javax.sql.rowset.CachedRowSet},
401   * see {@link dev.visdb.seesaw.navigate.RowSetState#acceptingCachedRowSetChanges}.
402   * This may contain two exceptions; one from {@code crs.acceptChanges()}, the
403   * other from {@code runAfterCachedRowSetChanges}
404   */
405  // TODO: handle flags argument to acceptCachedRowSetChanges.
406  @SuppressWarnings("serial")
407  private static class NOT_USED_SqlSyncProviderException extends SqlException {
408    private final Throwable causeAfter;
409
410    /**
411     *
412     * @param reason
413     * @param cause
414     * @param causeAfter
415     */
416    public NOT_USED_SqlSyncProviderException(String reason, SyncProviderException cause,
417                                               Throwable causeAfter) {
418      super(reason, cause);
419      this.causeAfter = causeAfter;
420    }
421
422    /**
423     * May be null.
424     * @return
425     */
426    @Override
427    public SyncProviderException getCause() {
428      return (SyncProviderException) super.getCause();
429    }
430
431    /**
432     * Throwable that occurred while executing after {@code crs.acceptChanges}.
433     * @return may be null
434     */
435    public Throwable getCauseAfter() {
436      return causeAfter;
437    }
438  }
